import os
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate a full-width or full-height separator line.
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]):
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom):
                return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(top))]
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]):
                return [[2 if left[i][j] != 0 and right[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(len(left[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No equal-sized regions separated by a solid line")
'''
